description: Check a document for concealed content BEFORE reading it. Text hidden in a file — white-on-white, zero-size fonts, text behind images, off-page runs, comments and tracked deletions — is invisible to a person but read verbatim by a model. Returns a recommended action, a plain reason, and the cleaned text to use instead of the file. Give a local file path where possible: analysing the file itself catches whole classes of concealment that are properties of the format and cannot be seen in extracted text.

filename.description: Just the name of a document the user attached, e.g. "contract.docx". Use this when they uploaded a file and you have no path: the server looks for the original in Downloads, Desktop and Documents and checks it in place, at full quality, reporting which file it used. Prefer this over `text` for an attachment.

path.description: Absolute path to a file on the machine running this server. Full quality. Not usable from a hosted session, whose uploads live on a different filesystem.

text.description: Raw text you already hold. LAST RESORT — this can only see invisible characters. White-on-white text, zero-size fonts and text behind images are properties of the file and are invisible here, so a result from this input is never a clean bill of health. Use path or url whenever one is possible.

url.description: URL to fetch and check. Full quality.

name: check_document
